item.tib: phyag rgya bzhi'i las sbyor nor bu rgyan gyi dril dbyangs
item.coloph: nor bu rgyan gyi dril dbyangs zhes bya 'di / … ces dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming can gyis / me byi spel zla'i ga ma khri brten nor bu rtser sbyar ba yin

item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi dpal mgon lcam dral gyi sbyin sreg thog mda' 'bar ba
item.coloph: ces dpal mgon lcam dral bcu drug la/ gtor mchod sbyin bsreg bya ba'i las/ nye bar mkho ba thog mda' 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis khri gdan nor bu'i rtser/ g.yul ngan rkyen gyi bskul ba'i tshe brtsams so/ /bstan dgra srog gi gshed mar shog mu tshug smar ro/ shu b+ham/ b+ha wan+tu// 13 'di'i 'jug gi shog lhe 621-622 bar dang 623-624 bar 'gres byang yod/
